reviews.title: Extremely disappointing experience
reviews.body:
Extremely disappointing experience. I have had No Service since 22 September after returning to the UK and switching back from my eSIM. My service had worked perfectly for around a month beforehand.

I have completed every troubleshooting step requested, including APN changes, network resets, manual network selection and removing/reinserting the SIM. I was even sent a completely new replacement SIM, but still have No Service.

I have spoken to agents every single day since then (both on lebara help chat and phone calls)  and been promised callbacks multiple times. I was told multiple that someone would contact me within specified timeframes, including a 48–72 hour escalation. Nobody contacted me.

I was eventually given complaint reference CAS-2948901-Y8N9P6 and promised an email and callback. Neither happened. I was then told someone would call within another 24 hours.

Nearly two weeks without service, repeated missed callbacks and no resolution. I would strongly reconsider using Lebara and will leave the network if this is not resolved urgently. I have had to buy another sim was another network to let me use my phone.

reviews.title: Terrible experience with Lebara
reviews.body:
Terrible experience with Lebara. My service was blocked for 3 days because they claim I sent business/marketing messages. I did not, and I told them this.
I was told their system could not have made a mistake, yet nobody has properly explained what actual messages triggered the block.
Even more seriously, Lebara later told me that while my service was barred, I could not call 999 for 3 days. Ofcom’s General Conditions require providers to ensure access to 999/112 and uninterrupted access to emergency services.
My service is now restored, but I want answers, accountability and reassurance this cannot happen to another customer.
They offered £14 compensation and asked me to remove my previous negative review. I want to know how this happened and what Lebara is doing to stop it happening again.
